title: Speed Switches QA

short.lead: The speed switches are built as house-rules 2.80.0 on branch AjsAgent/speed-switches, now with the two fixes from your first QA. You type "design loop off" or "builders off" as its own line to switch either off for a repo, and it stays off; a switch quoted inside a longer sentence is ignored. There is no Fable default any more: every model starts full. verify.py fails only the 7 checks main also fails on Windows (safe_git 79, 81, 177, 203; design_loop 259, 326; make_page A14).
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was checked and how.
items: Typed switches are saved, quoted ones are not

Running the real hooks: "design loop on" and "/house-rules:mode builders off" are saved to .claude/house-rules-mode.json; a prompt that quotes "Design loop OFF" inside a sentence saves nothing. With both off, the show-dont-tell rule and the delegation section leave the injected rules. A Fable session with nothing typed runs full. A relayed notification cannot flip a switch.
An approval always moves the stage

"Build plan approved" with no issues, no labels and no decisions log now moves to Build and tells the agent what to fix in the same turn. The same holds for wrong labels, a slightly different name, and QA verdicts. An unknown feature name and a QA verdict before any build still move nothing, because those need you to say which feature you meant.
The screenshot's wait loop is refused

The exact command from your screenshot, timeout 595 with an until-sleep loop, is refused and pointed at run_in_background. timeout 30 and one-off commands are untouched, and the same loop with run_in_background set is allowed.
Reruns reset on a code change

The third run of the same command on the same code is refused and asks for a fix first. An uncommitted change to any code file resets it; a docs change or an edit to the test script alone does not. A different command (other flags) is counted on its own.
Try it in a real session

Install the branch, open a new session in any repo and type "design loop off". The next reply should say the design loop is off and do the work without a page. Then type "design loop on" to switch back.
Run the three steps in the reply that linked this page.

changes: Every model starts full until you type a switch
The approved design started Fable light, but hooks are not told the model at session start, so it could not work.
Every model starts full; one typed line per repo switches it, and it stays switched.
Bookkeeping gaps become the agent's to-do
Your approval was dropped when issues, labels or the log entry were missing, and you had to send it again.
The stage moves, and the note lists what the agent must fix in that turn.
Loop off means the close guard is off (#515)
No demand for QA records the loop never kept
With the loop off, issue closes were still refused for missing QA records.
With the loop off, the close guard stands down.
Sleep loops and timeouts over 60 seconds
A wrapped sleep loop could hold a turn for ten minutes.
It is refused with the background form named.
Two runs per script until the next commit that changed code.
Two runs per exact command; any code change, committed or not, allows two more.

unverified: No desktop-app session has run 2.80.0 yet; the live tests ran real headless claude -p sessions with this branch's plugin (see the live-tests folder beside this page).

Your answer to choice 4 asked for a reset on the code the test touches. It resets on any code file in the repo instead, because a test reaches code through subprocesses its imports do not show (verify.py runs hook.py that way).
